{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique values in the 'arm' column to confirm the arms
print(trial_df['arm'].unique())

# Check the distribution of the 'responded' column
print(trial_df['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Filter for the treatment arm only
treatment_df = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the number of patients in the treatment arm
n_treatment = len(treatment_df)

# Check how many responded in the treatment arm
n_responded_treatment = treatment_df['responded'].sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded_treatment / n_treatment

# Print results
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {n_treatment}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {n_responded_treatment}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
